scenes.title: The terms
scenes.caption: Five short rules.
scenes.say: These are the terms. There are five, and they are short.

scenes.title: Use it for good
scenes.caption: Nothing against the law. No tricking or bullying people.
scenes.say: One. Use it for good. No reels that break the law, trick people, or bully anyone. And no pretending to be a real person or organisation.

scenes.title: Your reels are yours
scenes.caption: Pixel Reel does not claim them. What is in them is down to you.
scenes.say: Two. Your reels are yours. Pixel Reel does not claim them. But what is in them is down to you.

scenes.title: Check what matters
scenes.caption: For money, health or the law, check with whoever sent it.
scenes.say: Three. Check what matters. A reel keeps things simple. For money, health, legal or safety matters, check the details with whoever sent you the original.

scenes.title: No promises
scenes.caption: It may be slow, or down. Reels last 30 days at most.
scenes.say: Four. No promises. Pixel Reel may be slow, or down. It keeps reels for thirty days at most, and may delete one early if it breaks these terms.

scenes.title: Fair use
scenes.caption: There are limits, so it stays free for everyone.
scenes.say: Five. Fair use. There is a limit on how many reels anyone can make in an hour. That way, it stays free for everyone.
